stories.label: Iran war: Day 15 — Hegseth escalates while Trump says 'over soon'
stories.summary: Day 15. Hegseth announced 'most intense day yet' of US strikes while Trump simultaneously declared war 'pretty much over' — a public fracture between White House and Pentagon. Iran vows to 'fight as long as needed.' Iranian missiles analysis (MEE/Soylu) suggests deliberate mapping of NATO Kürecik radar coverage, raising Article 5 stakes. Mojtaba Khamenei consolidating as Supreme Leader. 1,300+ killed, 100,000+ displaced.

stories.label: Lebanon: France brings offensive to UN Security Council
stories.summary: France requested emergency UN Security Council meeting — first formal multilateral diplomatic intervention. 700,000 displaced, 400+ killed including 83 children. White phosphorus documented. Elections postponed two years. Diplomatic escalation matches military escalation; US veto threat looms.

stories.label: Hormuz crisis: Egypt fuel jumps, Russia wins, Pakistan probes war profiteers
stories.summary: Egypt 105M people hit by fuel price jumps. Russia emerges as major economic war winner — oil revenue up, Western pressure paused. Pakistan Senate probing war profiteers while citizens on 4-day week. Bitcoin $71K as Trump signals de-escalation. Algeria emerging as helium alternative to Iran supply disruption.

stories.label: Ukraine: Peace diplomacy shifts to Turkey for trilateral talks
stories.summary: Peace diplomacy shifts from Geneva to Turkey. Zelenskiy confirms trilateral format (Ukraine-Russia-US) with Erdoğan as host. US attention consumed by Iran war gives Erdoğan leverage to shape agenda. Frontline grinding continues.

stories.label: Iranian missiles mapping NATO's Kürecik early-warning radar
stories.summary: MEE/Soylu analysis: Iranian missiles may be deliberately mapping coverage gaps in Kürecik NATO radar. NATO rushed advanced Patriots to guard Kürecik. If struck, NATO loses 15-minute ballistic missile warning for Europe and Israel. Article 5 implications if Turkey base is targeted.

stories.label: Russia as major economic winner of Middle East war
stories.summary: Russia collecting economic dividends from Iran war: oil above $100, buyers rerouting from Gulf to Russian exports, Western pressure paused. War in Gulf is structurally a subsidy to Russian state revenue.

stories.label: Egypt: 105M people absorbing Iran war fuel shockwave
stories.summary: Egypt, already under IMF austerity, facing fuel price jumps from Hormuz crisis. 105M people with no mechanism to absorb war costs. Cooking gas, transport, bread subsidies all under pressure.

stories.label: Landmark study: 50% of UK news coverage of Muslims is biased
stories.summary: Landmark empirical study finds 50% of UK news articles about Muslims are biased. Drops during Iran war as anti-Muslim hate spikes on social media. Mainstream media bias study connects to last cycle's X hate spike study.

stories.label: Algeria emerges as helium alternative as Iran war disrupts supply
stories.summary: Iran war disrupts helium supply chains critical for MRI, semiconductors, and space systems. Algeria emerging as alternative source. Helium is non-renewable and essential to science infrastructure.

stories.label: CFTC moves to regulate DeFi and war prediction markets
stories.summary: CFTC chair signals regulatory action on DeFi and prediction markets. Connects to wartime prediction markets being used as intelligence extraction tools. Watch for specific rulemaking timeline.

stories.label: AI warfare: Enhanced real images harder to debunk than synthetic fakes
stories.summary: New layer: AI enhancement of real war images (not full fabrication) documented. Enhanced-real is harder to debunk than synthetic because the underlying event is genuine. Joins fake satellite imagery and unlabeled war footage as documented AI disinformation vectors in Iran war.

stories.label: US soldiers oppose Iran war — conscientious objector groups report dissent
stories.summary: Conscientious objector advocacy group reports significant opposition among serving US troops to Iran war. First organized military dissent since Iraq. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: Anthropic sues Pentagon — now in mainstream media (BBC)
stories.summary: Lawsuit in mainstream media. AI company designated 'supply chain risk' for refusing to drop safety restrictions. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: Anti-Muslim hate spike: X study → mainstream media bias study pipeline
stories.summary: Two consecutive cycles of empirical studies: (1) sharp spike in anti-Muslim posts on X since Iran war; (2) 50% of UK mainstream news about Muslims is biased. Together these document a media-to-social-media pipeline during wartime.

stories.label: Iran women's football team called 'wartime traitors' in Australia
stories.summary: Iran women's football team in Australia facing threats for not saluting during anthem. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: 434 Iranian sailors stranded in Sri Lanka/India after ships targeted
stories.summary: 434 sailors from 3 Iranian vessels given sanctuary by Sri Lanka and India. Both countries caught between US pressure and humanitarian obligations. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: Qatar arrests 313 for sharing footage of war attacks
stories.summary: Qatar arrested 313 for sharing footage during Iranian attacks. Gulf states criminalizing war documentation. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Nigeria: Boko Haram overruns army bases, commanding officer killed
stories.summary: Boko Haram overran military camp in Borno State, killing commanding officer. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: China reveals five-year climate goals at Two Sessions
stories.summary: China set new five-year climate targets at Two Sessions. World's largest emitter with potentially peaked CO2. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: US court: Companies can change TOS by email, use implies consent
stories.summary: Ninth Circuit: companies can update TOS by email, continued use implies consent. Effectively allows unilateral contract changes. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: China orders all officials to study rare earths and supply chains
stories.summary: Chinese officials across all ministries required to study rare earth elements and supply chains. China controls 60% rare earths, 80% gallium. Economic warfare capability being embedded. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: UK emissions fall 2.4%, coal at 400-year low
stories.summary: UK coal use at lowest since early 1600s. Emissions fell 2.4% in 2025. Gains threatened by Hormuz energy crisis driving UK back toward oil. Not followed up this cycle.

stories.label: West Bank: Settler attacks surge under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Settler violence surged 25% since Iran war. Military redeployed to other fronts. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: AI psychosis: Mental health experts warn of new clinical phenomenon
stories.summary: Mental health professionals treating delusional symptoms from AI interaction. No diagnostic framework exists. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Kenya floods: 42 killed as climate-intensified rains escalate
stories.summary: Death toll 42 across Kenya. Informal settlements hit hardest. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Sudan: War spreading — possible Sverige Radio humanitarian story this cycle
stories.summary: Sverige Radio story this cycle about malnourished pregnant women giving birth without medicine — writer to verify if this is Sudan. If confirmed: coverage gap broken after multiple cycles of silence. RSF starvation campaign continuing. Kordofan hospitals hit, supply routes cut.

stories.label: Gaza: Siege continues under total media blackout
stories.summary: WHO warned medical supplies exhausted. Rafah closed. No feed items for 4+ cycles. Most critical coverage gap. Sverige Radio story may alternatively be about Gaza.

stories.label: Study: Discrimination widespread across Germany
stories.summary: DW reports study/survey on widespread discrimination in Germany — dropping same day as Özdemir milestone. Writer to verify study methodology and commissioning body.

stories.label: Pakistan: $507M 5G auction during 4-day work week austerity
stories.summary: Pakistan completed 5G spectrum auction for $507M while implementing 4-day work week and school closures. Telecoms investing while citizens face austerity. Selective austerity pattern.
